entry.title: Peggle Deluxe v2.0.0
entry.content: This is a major feature release that also includes improvements. **This release is NOT compatible with games generated on the previous version.** - **Feature:** In-Game Level Locking - **Feature:** In-Game Master Locking - **Feature:** Progressive Fever Meter Threshold items have been completely replaced by level-specific Progressive Orange Pegs items, leading to more interesting and layered progression, as well as requiring a bit more skill for the early game phase - **Feature:** Fever mode no longer starts upon hitting the last orange peg when you have less than 25 orange pegs on a given level which should lessen confusion around level clear locations, as well as allowing easier chasing of full clears - **Feature:** Purple Pegs are now unlockable by level - **Feature:** Each Peggle Master now has their own set of Progressive Green Pegs items, creating opportunities for suboptimal masters to now be optimal to play under certain circumstances - **Improvement:** Starting level count increased from 1 to 3 - **Improvement:** Starting ball count is now set through a custom code patch instead of directly setting the memory value, meaning that the Ball-O-Tron will now always display the correct amount of balls - **Improvement:** Getting the required quantity of Gold Pegs is now all that's needed to access and clear the final level. No extra items to chase - **Improvement:** Added 3 extra copies of Progressive Starting Ball Increase and 1 extra copy of each Progressive Orange Pegs variant to allow for less restrictive progression and reaching the cap faster - **Improvement:** Slightly reworked logic, mainly around fever meter multipliers - **Improvement:** Custom client tab has been updated to reflect the new features _No new YAML options. Minimum level count is now 15 to make room for all the new items_ The implementation now has proper [documentation](https://github.com/SerpentAI/Archipelago/blob/peggle/worlds/peggle_deluxe/docs/en_Peggle_Deluxe.md) and a [setup guide](https://github.com/SerpentAI/Archipelago/blob/peggle/worlds/peggle_deluxe/docs/setup_en.md)

entry.title: ARK Survival Evolved v1.0.0r5
entry.content:
## Release Notes
1. **Fjordur is here**.
2. Midgard, Asgard, Jotunheim, and Vanaheim occupy the same world space at different elevations, so exploration regions now include altitude bands.
**81 exploration checks total:** - Midgard: 38 - Asgard: 20 - Vanaheim: 14 - Jotunheim: 9
3. **All 200 Fjordur Runes are now checks.** Runes are treated as Explorer Notes under the hood, so collecting one just works. Cave, underwater, and wyvern trench runes are gated behind the gear actually needed to reach them. The 45 runes in Asgard, Jotunheim, and Vanaheim currently contain filler only.
4. **The Norse bosses are now supported as goals.** Beyla, Hati & Sköll, and Steinbjörn lead into Fenrisúlfr. Boss kills are detected using the relic dropped by each fight instead of the boss corpse, so the kill still counts if you relog, another player gets the killing blow, or the corpse despawns. Hati & Sköll requires both relics.
5. **New goal setting:** choose any combination of bosses using a list.
```yaml goal: [broodmother, manticore, fenrisulfr] ```
`all_bosses` means every boss available across your selected maps. The default remains the four Island bosses.
**BREAKING CHANGE:** The following goal options no longer parse: - `all_bosses_all_maps` - `broodmother_megapithecus` - `broodmother_megapithecus_dragon`
Update your YAML accordingly.
6. **Fixed 32 engrams** that could previously be received but would never actually unlock. This includes Clay, Tent, Vessel, the full Adobe set, the Desert Cloth set, Wind Turbine, Thorny Dragon Saddle, and Rock Golem Saddle.
7. **Added 14 previously missing engrams:** Maewing, Velonasaur, Ravager, Amargasaurus, Roll Rat, Karkinos, Tropeognathus, Managarmr, and Magmasaur saddles, plus the full five-piece Hazard Suit. These saddles now correctly bundle with their associated tame when `bundle_saddles` is enabled. Previously, that setting did nothing for them.
8. **Unlock messages now explain why something unlocked.**
Example:
```text Explore: The Savage Heights (Asgard) unlocked for everyone on the server: Engram: ... ```
9. **No more trap floods from `!release` or `!collect`.** Bulk deliveries now skip traps, keep useful filler, and send a single notification in chat.
10. **Shared Slot + DeathLink now actually kills the entire server.** If one survivor dies, everyone dies. Previously, the death was sent to every other game in the multiworld while the survivors standing next to the corpse were left completely unaffected.
11. **51 dead-end cosmetics are now filler instead of useful items.** This includes signs, flags, furniture, elevators, pipes, trophies, and similar items that previously diluted the useful item pool. Actual gear remains useful.
12. **Added Mejoberry collection checks** and completed a broader food-tag pass.
13. **Datapackage updates:** - Engrams: 588 → 610 - Creatures: 127 → 142 - Exploration regions: 154 → 235 - Plugin: v177 → v187
14. **Generation sweep: 30/30 passing.** Configurations using `dossier_checks: 120` and `dossier_checks: 0` previously failed generation and now pass correctly.
---
## Tools
Attached are **Avocado's Launcher** and **Lurch's PopTracker**.
**Lurch's PopTracker:** https://github.com/lurch9229/Arkipelago-Poptracker/releases
**Avocado's Launcher:** https://github.com/aSoberAvocado/ARK-Ipelago-Evolved-Launcher/releases
I will be taking a break on adding new maps to the supported list as I am getting burnt out. I will be assisting Lurch with supporting the other released maps. I will continue working on bug fixes as they come up.

entry.title: Crash Team Racing v0.2.0
entry.content:
# CTR-AP v0.2.0
CTR Archipelago turns Crash Team Racing into a multiworld randomizer. A **check**, such as winning a race or breaking an AP box, awards an **item** that may go to you or another player. Your next character or kart upgrade can arrive from somebody else's game.
## At a glance
- Find AP boxes, individual CTR letters, weapon-use checks and Wumpa rewards. - Receive character unlocks, optional boost abilities and stat upgrades. - Shuffle Gem Cup tracks, add racer requirements to pads and combine Oxide, Boss and Gem goals. - Choose from twenty trap effects, with clearer pad displays, item messages and graphics settings. - AP-box contact is more forgiving, and secure connections now check both certificate trust and server name.
[Read the full 0.2.0 release notes on AP-Pie](https://ap-pie.com/ctr/reference/0-2-0-release-notes) for the options, fixes and experimental features.
## Where should I start?
- **Joining an existing room:** follow the [CTR setup guide](https://ap-pie.com/guides/ctr). Download the client, add your own disc image and use the connection details from your host. - **Preparing for a new room:** [build a 0.2.0 YAML](https://ap-pie.com/yaml-builder/ctr?version=0.2.0), your player settings file, and send it to your host. The [YAML guide](https://ap-pie.com/guides/setting-up-your-yaml) explains the format. - **Generating or hosting:** install the matching `ctr.apworld`, the package that adds CTR to Archipelago, and follow the [hosting guide](https://ap-pie.com/guides/hosting-a-multiworld). You do not need to install the APWorld just to join as a player.
Watch the [CTR setup video](https://youtu.be/9x63P6JP93E) or [hosting walkthrough](https://youtu.be/CpRbyRodayM). The setup video predates 0.2.0; use the current downloads and written guide alongside it. I'm also making a dedicated CTR 0.2.0 YAML explanation video, coming soon. The [CTR reference](https://ap-pie.com/ctr/reference) explains the available systems.
## Upgrading and downloads
For new games, use the matching 0.2.0 client, APWorld and YAML with a fresh seed. Back up your existing client folder, including settings and saves, before replacing it. For an ongoing room, check with the host before changing versions; older Alpha seeds are not automatically interchangeable with the final pair.
Download the Windows ZIP or Linux/Steam Deck tarball below. The small archive is expected: it contains the client, matching APWorld and setup/support files. Your own North American (NTSC-U) CTR disc supplies the large game assets. Debug symbols are separate downloads for investigating crashes and are not needed to play.
A raw `.bin` image works directly. `.chd` extraction needs Python and `chdman`. PAL/Japanese discs and cooked 2048-byte `.iso` images are not supported. Use the [current setup instructions](https://github.com/dowlle/ctr-native-ap/blob/main/SETUP.md) if you need more detail.
## Practical limitations and testing
Automated checks passed for the final release, including both platform builds, native and APWorld tests, all eleven generation fuzz checks and package verification. Some gameplay and connection scenarios still need community playtesting. Reports will feed into reproduced, verified fixes in matching 0.2.x releases.
- **Steam Deck:** leave Fullscreen off if it causes heavy lag. See [#260](https://github.com/dowlle/ctr-native-ap/issues/260). - **Reconnecting:** large item backlogs may cause a long pause. Include the support bundle when reporting one. - **Podiums:** some characters can appear invisible; see [#282](https://github.com/dowlle/ctr-native-ap/issues/282). - **Recorded AI:** experimental and off by default. Opponents share up to three recorded lines, so names can repeat. Per-racer assignment, finish-line smoothing and ordinary-crate interaction need further work. AI cannot collect AP check boxes. - **Custom content:** the narrow Baby T Park preview is experimental and off by default. Generalized custom tracks are planned for 0.3.0. - **Planned for 0.2.1:** recorded-AI corrections, Nitro Drop/Red Potion balance improvements and optional checks for breaking every Relic Race time crate.
## About this release
With much of my attention on my partner's recovery, I've relied more than usual on AI assistance for this release. Astra coordinated implementation, reviews and release preparation around plans and priorities we had already agreed on.
## Credits
- The [CTR-tools CTR-ModSDK decompilation project](https://github.com/CTR-tools/CTR-ModSDK). - Icebound777 and Taor for the CTR randomizer work this integration builds on. - PsyCross for parts of the PlayStation platform layer. - SDL3 and the Archipelago client libraries.
Crash Team Racing is a trademark of its respective rights holders. This is an unofficial fan project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by them.
## Download checksums
| Asset | SHA-256 | |---|---| | `ctr-archipelago-v0.2.0-windows-x86.zip` | `f0198aeaaea187de8a7e639121628a6f51fc5fb3e6ef3023e58a10e41f0dc0e6` | | `ctr-archipelago-v0.2.0-linux-x86.tar.gz` | `c1ae14997aecceaf11afbf855e66b73b81fdf3aef7b578e2b1ecde0267b2f384` | | `ctr.apworld` | `d40fba25eac9ddf88fe47cfed7b73825d2a32d4f004f7b6467952b1442f5c685` |
## Reporting a problem
[Open a GitHub issue](https://github.com/dowlle/ctr-native-ap/issues/new/choose) with your client version, platform, seed or YAML and what happened. Include the local support bundle when relevant: run `support-bundle.bat` on Windows or `support-bundle.sh` on Linux and inspect it before attaching it. It does not upload automatically.

entry.title: Team Fortress 2 Mann vs Machine v1.13.0
entry.content: ## Changes The launcher has one screen now, and it opens in your browser. ### The new interface - Double-click the launcher and a browser opens on it. Same screen on Windows and on Linux, so a screenshot in Discord is a screenshot of what you have. - Everything is on it: the connect line, the run and its missions, what the multiworld has unlocked, your bot team, the log with a search over it, and every setting. - The log holds twenty thousand lines and stays quick to scroll, and the search narrows it as you type. The server command box is under it. - The mission table sorts on any column, searches, and says why a mission is not ready rather than leaving it out. - Leaving the tab open behind the game costs nothing: it stops listening while it is hidden and picks the state back up when you come back to it. - Closing the tab leaves the server running. On Windows the launcher sits in the notification area while it does: click the icon to get the page back, right-click it for Quit. Quit on the screen stops it too. - The settings open when you go to them. There is no button to press first. - A settings page with sections shows them as tabs across the top, one at a time. Bots is Team, Classes, Looks and Loadouts, each a screen rather than a scroll; a search still finds a setting whatever tab it is on. - The Team tab is a grid of six seats with the fill controls above it; the Classes tab is one line per class, allowed or not and what it carries. - Loadouts is a builder: pick the class, a weapon per slot, name it. The saved ones are a list with Load and Remove on each line. - The mission pool is one table, the same one the Play screen has, with a tick per mission and the tier beside it. It was drawn twice. - The console is under the missions on the Play screen, the same width, with the search, the command box, Save debug logs and Clear this view. There is no Console tab. - Join is in the header, left of Start, and the Bot Switcher has Apply: the seats are a draft, and a lineup built there was gone on the next visit because nothing wrote it. - Star on GitHub, in a footer that stays put. ### Gone - The old settings window and the terminal interface are both gone. The browser is what you get. - `-tui` and `-web` are gone with them. `-console` still prints the log and nothing over it, for a machine with no desktop; `-configure` still asks the questions in a terminal. - New: `-no-browser` prints the address instead of opening one, and `-addr` says where to serve. ### If the browser does not open The address is printed either way. Open it yourself. On WSL the launcher asks the Windows browser rather than one inside the distribution, where you could not see it. ### Fixed - A saved loadout handed to a seat or a class plays that loadout. It played stock: the menu wrote the loadout's name where its key belongs. A settings file written by 1.12 still works, the name is understood too. ## Windows Download **`tf2ap.exe`** above. Run it. It installs everything else. Windows will warn you, and it is a false positive. The exe unpacks archives and starts a game server without a code signature, which looks like a virus to a scanner. Click **More info**, then **Run anyway**, or check it below first. [Full guide](https://m-this.github.io/tf2-archipelago/en/setup/install-windows.html) ## Linux Download **`tf2ap-linux-amd64`**. Run it. It installs everything else. ```sh chmod +x tf2ap-linux-amd64 ./tf2ap-linux-amd64 ``` [Full guide](https://m-this.github.io/tf2-archipelago/en/setup/install-linux.html) ## Docker Download **`compose.yaml`** and **`.env.example`**: ```sh mkdir mann-vs-archipelago && cd mann-vs-archipelago base=https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/releases/latest/download curl -fsSLO "$base/compose.yaml" curl -fsSL -o .env "$base/.env.example" ``` Set `SRCDS_RCONPW` in `.env`, then: ```sh docker compose --profile seed run --rm seed # writes ./seed docker compose up -d ``` Upload the file from `seed/` at [archipelago.gg/uploads](https://archipelago.gg/uploads) and put the room's port into `AP_PORT`. [Full guide](https://m-this.github.io/tf2-archipelago/en/setup/install.html) ## Other assets | File | For | | --- | --- | | `tf2_mvm.apworld` | The official Archipelago app. | | `tf2_archipelago.smx` | A SourceMod server the launcher and compose file don't manage. | | `tf2-defender-bots.zip` | The bots for that same server. Unzip into `tf/`. | | `meta.json`, `items.json`, `missions.json` | The item and check tables, for reference. | ## Checking what you downloaded **`SHA256SUMS`** is attached to this release. It holds the hash of every file here, computed by the workflow that built them. ```powershell Get-FileHash tf2ap.exe -Algorithm SHA256 # Windows ``` ```sh sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS --ignore-missing # Linux ``` Each binary carries a signed record of the commit and the workflow that built it: ```sh gh attestation verify tf2ap.exe --repo m-this/tf2-archipelago ``` The binaries are scanned on VirusTotal, and the reports are linked at the end of these notes. Expect a few heuristic detections and no named malware family. The source is all in the repository, and `make launcher` rebuilds the exe on your own machine. ## Code signing policy Free code signing for open source projects, provided by [SignPath.org](https://signpath.org), with a certificate from the [SignPath Foundation](https://signpath.org). > [!WARNING] > The application is open, not granted. Nothing is signed yet: `tf2ap.exe` ships > unsigned, and Windows warns about it until that changes. ## What's Changed * feat(launcher): find Archipelago on Linux by @kelly-cs in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/52 * fix(plugin): fix disposable sentry ap buff by @kelly-cs in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/53 * fix(webui): render session mission details by @kelly-cs in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/51 * fix(fastdl): clarify Linux Funnel onboarding by @kelly-cs in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/45 * Web UI by @m-this in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/49 * fix(launcher): a saved loadout handed to a seat plays it, not stock by @m-this in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/55 * feat(launcher): a tray icon on Windows, and the settings open themselves by @m-this in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/54 * feat(web): settings sections as tabs, a Bots overhaul, one missions table, Join and Apply by @m-this in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/56 * feat(web): the console under the missions, the settings land on a page, and the Join fix for main by @m-this in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/57 **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/compare/v1.12.0...v1.13.0 ## VirusTotal - [`tf2ap.exe`](https://www.virustotal.com/gui/file-analysis/NzU3YjMyOTMzMWY5MWNhOWQzZGM5NTU0NmI4ZTFiZTg6MTc4OTA3Njk0NA==/detection) - [`tf2ap-linux-amd64`](https://www.virustotal.com/gui/file-analysis/MmU3N2Q5ZmNmY2Q3ZDI3NzcwZjE3ZDlkN2EwMWU0ZjA6MTc4OTA3Njk1MA==/detection)

entry.title: Peggle Deluxe v2.1.0
entry.content:
This is an improvement release that also includes tweaks.
**This release is NOT compatible with games generated on the previous version.**
- **Improvement:** Instead of downgrading orange pegs once the board is already loaded (which mostly worked but was risky and had side effects.), levels now spawn the correct amount of orange pegs as they load. While this change required a lot of extra reverse engineering effort (on top of figuring out how to hook level loading, the game's multiplier system and the way the fever meter fills also had to be rewritten to match), it totally gets rid of _all_ weirdness that could be observed in 2.0.0. The implementation should feel rock solid now - **Tweak:** Because of this improvement, fever modes are forced to go back to triggering whenever the last orange peg is hit even if you don't have 25 for a given level - **Tweak:** To avoid reintroducing the confusion that was present in 1.x.x around getting fever mode and no completion check, Level Clear location checks will now unlock after any fever mode completes. They will require half your starting ball items logically, but nothing prevents them from triggering - **Tweak:** To preserve the relevance of the 4th Progressive Orange Pegs item now that level completions have moved to the early-mid game, new Fever Meter Full location checks have been added - **Tweak:** Permanent Fever Meter Bonus useful items have been removed. They also contributed to general weirdness and instability
_No new YAML options. However, you will need to remove Permanent Fever Meter Bonus from your useful item weights for existing YAMLs to be valid_

entry.title: Red Prince v1.0.15
entry.content:
# Red Prince 1.0.15
## Gameplay and logic
- Added optional first-observation checks for all 13 constellations through `constellation_sanity`. Normal constellation effects still occur. - Added `exclude_north_star`: North Star remains a check but contains filler when enabled. Other constellations can contain progression for any player. - Constellation logic assumes repeatable Observatory drafts across days to gain stars, and Ink Well redraws to revisit skipped star counts. It models eventual access, not the current night's sky; farming may take many days. - A supplied in-game log confirms North Star activation sent its check and awarded Extra Dice 1. Multiple simultaneous constellations, controller input, and repeat-observation persistence still need in-game confirmation. - Added warm-white, lightly yellow-tinted borders for undrafted room choices, using the game's electricity-border geometry and bloom. Visual retest pending. - Pool trunk checks now require Gift Shop and Pump Room access. Corrected the shared Pool rule that previously treated a location name as an item. - Planetarium trunk checks require telescope access. Trunks with unmodeled luck or upgrade requirements remain excluded from progression placement.
## Inventory - attempted fixes
- Fixed the identified code path that restored Workshop recipe unlocks as physical crafted items on the following day with Keep Simple Items Every Run. - Workshop rewards now remain recipe unlocks in the automatic grant path and cannot auto-complete their crafting checks through item restoration. - The Workshop fix compiles; normal crafting and next-day behavior still need in-game retesting. Previously sent checks are not rolled back. - Corrected runtime loading/reset of DeathLink protection and reporting of constellation options and filler/trap distributions.
## Known issues
- Missing or unpickupable upgrade disks are not fixed by disk pickup-event detection or by using the game's generic disk inventory object/icon. - Upgrade-disk duplication through Coat Check remains unresolved. - The previously reported microchip duplication and placement-time crash have no confirmed resolution or established common cause. - Ordinary-item delivery delays remain under investigation; Workshop recipes are distinct from physical-item delivery. - Runtime tests do not replace Unity playtesting. This release does not claim to fix the remaining issues listed in UNRESOLVED_PROBLEMS.txt.
## Check names and documentation
- Published YAML includes both constellation options and all public world options. Personal test starting stars, gems, and room unlocks are not included. - Existing location IDs remain stable. New checks use `Constellation - <name> First Observation`. - Updated the attempted-fix and unresolved-issue logs to distinguish source fixes, automated verification, confirmed gameplay, and pending playtests.
## Compatibility
- Minimum Archipelago version: 0.6.7. Compatibility with every newer version has not been verified. - BepInEx 6 IL2CPP build 755; plugin target remains .NET 6. - The 1.0.15 game plugin and 1.0.15 APWorld should be distributed together. - Generate a new seed for constellation locations and changed generation rules. Updating the plugin alone does not change an existing multiworld.
## Verification
- 92 world tests passed, public YAML generation succeeded, all 29 public options are present, and runtime option tests passed on .NET 6.0.36. - Release compilation passed with existing dependency/analyzer warnings. NuGet vulnerability metadata could not be fetched during the runtime-test restore. - Automated checks do not confirm resolution of the pending in-game issues above.

entry.title: Final Fantasy VIII v0.6.0
entry.content:
## Story Keys
FF8 finally has doors. Twenty **"Key: <area>"** items, one per world-map entrance (Balamb, Dollet, Timber, Deling City, Winhill, Trabia Garden, Esthar City, Lunar Gate, the chocobo forests, ...). Without the key the town's entrance simply does not work: you walk onto it, nothing happens, and the client says `Locked: Key: Dollet`. The moment the key lands the door works again, right where you stand. No story faking, no file patching: the client rewrites one word of the table the game consults every step, and puts it back when the key arrives.
- `story_keys: areas` — every key is a real door and the checks inside need it in logic, but the story path is never blocked. - `story_keys: story` — the doors the main line walks through stay shut too, so advancing the story needs keys other players hold. Balamb and Fire Cavern keys are yours from the start. - Keys carry their `/ff8warp` destination. New preset **Story Keys** (Staircase + `story_keys: story`). - Keys never open a town before the story does (early entry works, but town interiors assume the story state, so it stays off). - Also: the study panel credits both starter GFs when one is precollected (thanks Lexra), and the Jukebox trap picks from five tracks.
Off by default while the feature is new. **Stability note:** v0.5.0 remains the stable release; report anything odd with `/ff8` output and the client log. Tracker pack 0.12.0 shows the keys and mirrors the rules.

Picking Mythic+ now only shows the categories your run actually uses, instead of also listing every other expansion with nothing in them.
### FIXED - Corrected the "Include Wrath of the Lich King" description: it said 16 dungeons, but it's actually been 12 since an earlier prune.

entry.title: Crash Team Racing v0.2.1a1
entry.content:
# CTR Archipelago v0.2.1-alpha1
This prerelease adds more ways to race Turbo Track and Slide Coliseum, brings Cortex Vortex to the Oxide 2 showdown, and fixes a few frustrating hub issues.
It is available for testing and feedback. **0.2.0 remains the latest stable release.**
## Getting started
Download `ctr-archipelago-0.2.1-alpha1-windows-x86.zip` below. It includes the client and matching `ctr.apworld`; use both together when setting up a new game.
Follow the [CTR setup guide](https://ap-pie.com/guides/ctr) or the `SETUP.md` included in the ZIP. [Setup instructions are also available here](https://github.com/dowlle/ctr-native-ap/blob/main/SETUP.md). You will need your own game disc; the download does not include the original game's assets.
## What's new
- **Turbo Track and Slide Coliseum:** Both now support Trophy Races and CTR Challenges, including lettersanity and the same position/podium checks as other tracks. Their hub minimap colors now follow the usual rules, and letters you have not unlocked appear translucent. Trophy podium checks only count in Trophy Races, just like on other tracks. - **Cortex Vortex:** This custom track is included in the download and is now the default track for Oxide 2. The crash encountered during this race has been fixed. - **Optional Oxide 1:** If your goal is Oxide 2, you can now choose whether you need to beat Oxide 1 first. See the settings below. - **Hub doors:** Doors between hubs and the door to the Gem Cup room now stay open after reloading your game. - **Character changes:** Changing characters in the hub transition tunnels no longer freezes the game. - **CTR letters notification:** With lettersanity set to send letters as items, the event timeline tells you when you have received all the letters needed for a track's CTR Challenge. For example: `Dragon Mines: Got CTR letters`. It can appear while you are in the hub, and letters you have already picked up still count. It is a reminder that you can go collect the CTR Token, not an automatic Token reward. - **Baby T Park:** The existing option to use Baby T Park in the Purple Gem Cup is still supported. Full CTR Challenge, relic and lettersanity support across custom tracks is not included yet.
## Choosing whether to race Oxide 1
Set `oxide_1_optional` in your YAML when your goal is Oxide 2:
- `mandatory`: Beat Oxide 1 before you can race Oxide 2. This is the default. - `optional`: You can race Oxide 2 as soon as its other requirements are met. Oxide 1 can still hold an item you need, so skipping it is not always practical. - `filler`: You can skip Oxide 1, and its reward is guaranteed to be filler rather than progression. Winning Oxide 2 also collects the skipped Oxide 1 location.
For goals other than Oxide 2, Oxide 1 keeps its normal required behavior.
## Before you play
- **Older YAMLs:** The tested 0.2.0 settings with numeric relic counts generate successfully, with Cortex Vortex as the default Oxide 2 track. If a relic-count setting uses `all`, replace it with `18`; `all` currently causes generation to fail. - **Development seeds:** YAMLs explicitly requiring world version `0.3.0` need updating or regenerating for this `0.2.1` world. Existing development rooms may show a version notice without the client refusing the connection. Keep the apworld used to generate an existing room for its server and Universal Tracker. - **Known boss-box issue:** AP boxes can still appear in boss races when the track's regular warp pad is locked. This release does not fix that issue. - **Still being tested:** Hub doors, tunnel character changes, both tracks' minimap colors, Slide Coliseum letters/podium checks, and a complete Cortex Vortex Oxide 2 race have been confirmed in Steam testing. Turbo Track's letters/podium checks, the shorter notification text, and other Oxide 2 track/chaos combinations still need gameplay confirmation.
If you find a problem, please report it through the repository's Issues tab with your client version, YAML, what happened, and `ctr-ap.log`.
## Downloads and technical details
The ZIP is the main player download. The separate `ctr.apworld` and YAML are provided for convenience. `.sha256` files let you check that downloads are intact; the `.debug` file is for diagnosing crashes and is not needed to play. The client is not code-signed, and no antivirus clearance is claimed.
Both the client and apworld use compatibility version **0.2.1**, with build label **0.2.1-alpha1**. Automated world tests, native tests, and Windows/Linux builds all passed. The world tests include 1,522 passing tests and a 17,000-run generation matrix with no failures or timeouts.
Source is tagged `v0.2.1-alpha1` in both repositories. Exact source revisions are recorded in the ZIP's `BUILD.json`.
